description: This file defines classes and methods related to the AutoHeuristic framework in PyTorch's _inductor module. It includes classes for collecting feedback, managing heuristics, and selecting algorithms based on learned models, specifically targeting GPU kernel choices and autotuning processes.

classes.name: LocalFeedback
classes.description: Class for providing immediate feedback for choices, encapsulating a feedback function that maps choices to feedback.

classes.name: InconsistentMetadata
classes.description: Custom exception raised when metadata in logs does not match expected structure.

classes.name: AutoHeuristic
classes.description: Framework class for collecting data, training heuristics, and making decisions based on learned models or fallback options.

classes.name: AutoHeuristicSelectAlgorithm
classes.description: Subclass of AutoHeuristic specific to selecting algorithms (e.g., kernel choices) and integrating feedback collection into the process.

methods.name: LocalFeedback.__init__
methods.description: Initializes with a feedback function that provides feedback given a choice.

methods.name: LocalFeedback.__call__
methods.description: Allows the instance to be called as a function to get feedback for a given choice.

methods.name: InconsistentMetadata.__init__
methods.description: Initializes the exception with a relevant error message.

methods.name: AutoHeuristic.__init__
methods.description: Sets up the AutoHeuristic instance with choices, feedback, context, and configuration, and initializes metadata and logging.

methods.name: AutoHeuristic.satisfies_precondition
methods.description: Checks if the precondition for running heuristic is satisfied.

methods.name: AutoHeuristic.get_choice
methods.description: Returns a choice based on the learned heuristic or fallback.

methods.name: AutoHeuristic.get_top_k_choices
methods.description: Returns top-k ranked choices from the learned heuristic.

methods.name: AutoHeuristic.get_collected_feedback
methods.description: Retrieves stored feedback for a specific choice.

methods.name: AutoHeuristic.get_device_identifier
methods.description: Generates a device identifier string based on GPU name for logging purposes.

methods.name: AutoHeuristic.get_default_log_path
methods.description: Constructs the default file path for logging data based on device.

methods.name: AutoHeuristic.serialize_metadata
methods.description: Serializes heuristic metadata into a JSON string for storage.

methods.name: AutoHeuristic.save_data
methods.description: Saves feedback data for a choice into the log file, ensuring consistency of metadata.

methods.name: AutoHeuristicSelectAlgorithm.__init__
methods.description: Initializes for kernel selection, maps choices, and optionally registers global feedback.

methods.name: AutoHeuristicSelectAlgorithm.register_global_feedback
methods.description: Registers a callback to save feedback globally during algorithm selection.

methods.name: AutoHeuristicSelectAlgorithm.get_choice_caller
methods.description: Returns the current choice as a ChoiceCaller object.

methods.name: AutoHeuristicSelectAlgorithm.get_top_k_choices_caller
methods.description: Returns a list of the top-k choices as ChoiceCaller objects.
